posts.title: AI API prices rose more than they fell this week
posts.excerpt: This week's AI pricing digest counted more price increases than cuts across the models it tracks. The biggest cut was Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, whose input price fell to zero.
posts.body: This week's [AI pricing digest](https://veprompts.com/reports/weekly-pricing-digest/) counted more price increases than cuts across the models it tracks. The biggest cut was Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, whose input price fell to zero.

posts.title: Trump signs bill ending longest shutdown after 222–209 House vote
posts.excerpt: Federal workers are due back on the job Thursday, with back pay to follow. The package funds most of the government through January 30, 2027.
posts.body: Federal workers are due back on the job Thursday, with back pay to follow. [The package funds most of the government through January 30, 2027](https://nexanewshd.com/trump-signs-bill-ends-longest-government-shutdown/).

posts.title: Two dozen abused children rushed toward deportation
posts.excerpt: At least two dozen children, ages 6 to 18, in the Kansas City area are now in active deportation proceedings, and some could soon be ordered removed, the Missouri Independent reported. The…
posts.body: At least two dozen children, ages 6 to 18, in the Kansas City area are now in active deportation proceedings, and some could soon be ordered removed, [the Missouri Independent reported](https://missouriindependent.com/2026/11/11/dozens-of-immigrant-children-in-kc-face-fast-tracked-deportation-after-losing-protections/). The deferred-action protection that kept them from being pursued while their green-card cases moved forward was canceled for new grants and renewals effective May 10, 2026.

posts.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon for coding and cybersecurity
posts.excerpt: Introductory API pricing for Gemini 4 Carbon is $2 per million input tokens through November 30, 2026, before it doubles on December 1. Google built it for multi-step coding, debugging and open-ended…
posts.body: [Introductory API pricing](https://www.fonearena.com/blog/496805/google-gemini-4-carbon-roll-out.html) for Gemini 4 Carbon is $2 per million input tokens through November 30, 2026, before it doubles on December 1. Google built it for multi-step coding, debugging and open-ended research.

posts.title: Gels every five miles anchor Dec. 13 marathon plan
posts.excerpt: The plan for the Brownsville Chief of Police Marathon on Dec. 13 keeps the run-walk rhythm for a finish under five hours. That rhythm only works if the run segments stay near 9:30 per mile or the…
posts.body: The plan for the Brownsville Chief of Police Marathon on Dec. 13 keeps the run-walk rhythm for a finish under five hours. That rhythm only works if the run segments stay near 9:30 per mile or the walk stays brisk.

posts.title: Starship Flight 15 tests full recovery on Nov. 13
posts.excerpt: SpaceX is targeting Friday, November 13, at 4:45 PM CST for Starship Flight 15 from Starbase, Texas, in the first attempt to catch both stages at the launch tower. Ship 42 would circle Earth about 14…
posts.body: [SpaceX is targeting Friday, November 13, at 4:45 PM CST](https://texasborderbusiness.com/spacex-starship-flight-15-tests-mission-for-full-vehicle-recovery-demonstration-nov-13th/) for Starship Flight 15 from Starbase, Texas, in the first attempt to catch both stages at the launch tower. Ship 42 would circle Earth about 14 times over more than 22 hours before its own catch attempt around 3:17 PM CST on Saturday, November 14.

posts.title: Judge orders USCIS to undo violations of child asylum order
posts.excerpt: On November 10, Judge Brendan Hurson ordered USCIS to remedy its non-compliance with his October 30 temporary restraining order restoring 21-day written notice and rescheduling for unaccompanied…
posts.body: On November 10, Judge Brendan Hurson ordered USCIS to remedy its non-compliance with his October 30 temporary restraining order restoring 21-day written notice and rescheduling for unaccompanied children's asylum interviews, after the [six legal-aid plaintiffs'](https://youthlaw.org/cases/the-door-v-edlow/) November 5 sworn affidavits described reschedule requests denied or ignored. It requires USCIS to vacate failure-to-appear notices issued October 30–November 9 where a reschedule request consistent with the order was denied or unanswered.

posts.title: Senate passes shutdown deal; House votes Wednesday
posts.excerpt: The House is expected to hold its final vote on the shutdown deal Wednesday evening. When it reconvenes Wednesday, it will be the House's first session in 54 days.
posts.body: The House is expected to hold its [final vote on the shutdown deal](https://newsoneusa.com/senate-passes-deal-to-end-longest-us-government-shutdown-as-house-vote-nears/) Wednesday evening. When it reconvenes Wednesday, it will be the House's first session in 54 days.

posts.title: Create My Widget arrives in November Pixel Drop
posts.excerpt: The November Pixel Drop brings Create My Widget to the Pixel 11 and Pixel 10. The generative feature builds custom homescreen objects from natural-language descriptions.
posts.body: [The November Pixel Drop](https://9to5google.com/2026/11/10/november-2026-pixel-feature-drop/) brings Create My Widget to the Pixel 11 and Pixel 10. The generative feature builds custom homescreen objects from natural-language descriptions.

posts.title: 32GB DDR5 kits climb past $550
posts.excerpt: The cheapest 32GB DDR5 kits climbed past $550 by early November. AI data centers are buying the same wafers for high-bandwidth memory, leaving PC builders with what is left.
posts.body: The [cheapest 32GB DDR5 kits climbed past $550](https://ismagazine.com/Home/Post/8928/Why-Is-RAM-So-Expensive-in-2026-The-AI-Memory-Squeeze-Explained) by early November. AI data centers are buying the same wafers for high-bandwidth memory, leaving PC builders with what is left.

posts.title: Six lawmakers demand to know where the Haitian boy is held
posts.excerpt: On Tuesday, Representatives Juan Vargas, Sara Jacobs, Mike Levin and Scott Peters, and Senators Alex Padilla and Adam Schiff sought confirmation from the federal government of the child's whereabouts…
posts.body: On Tuesday, Representatives Juan Vargas, Sara Jacobs, Mike Levin and Scott Peters, and Senators Alex Padilla and Adam Schiff [sought confirmation from the federal government of the child's whereabouts and whether his family had been told his location](https://www.news-mash.com/2026/11/10/lawmakers-seek-whereabouts-of-haitian-boy-taken-at-ice-appointment/). His family still did not know where he is being held as of Monday, six days after he was [taken at a routine ICE check-in in San Diego](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2026/11/07/haitian-third-grader-taken-into-federal-custody/92661950007/).

posts.title: Senate passes bill to end shutdown 60-40
posts.excerpt: Eight Democrats broke ranks on Monday night to join Republicans. The deal guarantees back pay for nearly 800,000 federal workers.
posts.body: [Eight Democrats broke ranks](https://red-bear-785726.hostingersite.com/government-shutdown-ends-senate-passes-bill/) on Monday night to join Republicans. The deal guarantees back pay for nearly 800,000 federal workers.

posts.title: San Diego Unified demands closer school placements
posts.excerpt: San Diego Unified leaders, in a November 6 letter to DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin and HHS Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr, demanded HHS and ORR place unaccompanied children as close as possible to…
posts.body: San Diego Unified leaders, in a November 6 letter to DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin and HHS Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr, demanded HHS and ORR place unaccompanied children as close as possible to their home schools and consult local districts before relocation decisions, according to [USA TODAY](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/state/california/2026/11/09/san-diego-unified-haitian-child-ice-dhs-custody/92696559007/). DHS disputed the district's account, calling claims that ICE took a third grader into custody for detention "FALSE" and saying the incident occurred November 5, not November 4, and that the man who brought the boy was not his uncle.

posts.title: SpaceX goes for a Starship double catch
posts.excerpt: Flight 15 opens its 75-minute window at 4:45 PM CT on Friday, November 13, from Starbase. Ship will then spend more than 22 hours in orbit before attempting the tower catch the next day.
posts.body: [Flight 15 opens its 75-minute window at 4:45 PM CT on Friday, November 13](https://www.astronomy.com/whats-launching-this-week/spacex-goes-for-a-starship-double-catch/), from Starbase. Ship will then spend more than 22 hours in orbit before attempting the tower catch the next day.

posts.title: Zelda remake gets two native PC ports with frame generation
posts.excerpt: Hookshot and NX2navi rebuild the Zelda remake natively for PC, with frame generation and DLSS/FSR upscaling. On one tester's RTX 5090, frame generation pushed Hookshot to 180 fps.
posts.body: [Hookshot and NX2navi](https://wccftech.com/zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-pc-recompilation-switch-2-emulator-ps5/) rebuild the Zelda remake natively for PC, with frame generation and DLSS/FSR upscaling. On one tester's RTX 5090, frame generation pushed Hookshot to 180 fps.
